# require-is-valid-call-check

Ensure methods that throw `DisconnectedError` are preceded by
`receiver.isValid()` in the same synchronous scope.

`AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent.allowJoin`, `disallowJoin`, and `disconnect` throw
[`DisconnectedError`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/minecraft/creator/scriptapi/minecraft/server-admin/disconnectederror)
once the client has already left. That happens when an `asyncPlayerJoin`
callback awaits (ban lookup, table load) and the player drops or the join
times out before the callback settles. `isValid()` is the pre-check, and it is
a **method**. A property read (`if (!ctx.isValid) return`) is the function
object, which is always truthy, so it does not count.

The rule discovers targets from installed typings: any method in the tracked
modules whose JSDoc mentions `DisconnectedError` (`@throws` or
`{@link DisconnectedError}`). A later async callback with the same throw is
covered without a rule change. Reads that do not document the error (`name`,
`persistentId`) are left alone.

## How it works

1. **API discovery** — Member calls whose symbol documents `DisconnectedError`.
2. **Guard recognition** — `receiver.isValid()` (no arguments) in the same
   synchronous stretch:
   - positive `if` / `&&` / ternary consequent
   - negative early-exit `if (!receiver.isValid()) return/throw/continue/break`
   - `const event = ctx` aliases resolve to the same receiver
3. **Invalidation** — Proofs clear after `await` / `yield`, and do not cross
   deferred callbacks (`system.run`, `system.runTimeout`, Promise
   continuations). Sync array callbacks (`forEach`, `map`, …) inherit the
   enclosing proof.

`try/catch` around the call is not a proof. The throw is what this rule
exists to avoid.

## Examples

### ❌ Incorrect

```ts
import { beforeEvents } from '@minecraft/server-admin';

beforeEvents.asyncPlayerJoin.subscribe(async ctx => {
  await loadBan(ctx.name);
  // Client may already be gone. allowJoin throws DisconnectedError.
  ctx.allowJoin();
});
```

```ts
import { AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent } from '@minecraft/server-admin';

async function admit(ctx: AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent) {
  if (!ctx.isValid()) return;
  await loadBan(ctx.name);
  // Proof invalidated by await
  ctx.allowJoin();
}
```

```ts
import { AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent } from '@minecraft/server-admin';

function admit(ctx: AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent) {
  if (!ctx.isValid) return; // property read, not a call
  ctx.allowJoin();
}
```

### ✅ Correct

```ts
import { beforeEvents } from '@minecraft/server-admin';

beforeEvents.asyncPlayerJoin.subscribe(async ctx => {
  await loadBan(ctx.name);
  if (!ctx.isValid()) return;
  ctx.allowJoin();
});
```

```ts
import { AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent } from '@minecraft/server-admin';

function settle(ctx: AsyncPlayerJoinBeforeEvent, reason?: string): void {
  if (!ctx.isValid()) return;
  if (reason !== undefined) ctx.disallowJoin(reason);
  else ctx.allowJoin();
}
```

## Options

### `trackedModules` (default: `['@minecraft/server', '@minecraft/server-admin']`)

Modules whose methods are scanned for `DisconnectedError`.

```js
{
  'minecraft-isvalid/require-is-valid-call-check': [
    'error',
    {
      trackedModules: ['@minecraft/server', '@minecraft/server-admin'],
    },
  ],
}
```
